subject: Fix auto-imports of aliased packages with `exports` (#52538)

triage.reason: Auto-import module specifier generation for aliased packages under `exports` used the package.json name instead of the actual node_modules directory name, producing wrong specifiers. The fix is in moduleSpecifiers.ts and adds fourslash coverage.
